explanation: The statement is about the library's own definition `vectorGroupCoordinateBialgHom`. It is a bialgebra map on the symmetric algebra of the dual space, built from `vectorGroupCoordinateMap`, which pulls back coordinates along a linear map. The statement says this map is the identity when the linear map is `LinearMap.id`. Grepping Mathlib for `vectorGroupCoordinate` found nothing. I did not search Mathlib for a general functoriality lemma on the symmetric algebra (such as a `SymmetricAlgebra.map` id lemma) that could give this as a short special case. The proof is also not one line: it needs `SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext` plus `ext` and `simp`.
